purpose: Synthetic analytic tests of empirical sensitivity reporting; not ephemeris validation or timing bounds.

policy.relativeSpreadDenominator: maximum of the two absolute rates

checks.description: Exact linear rate yields unsigned local equivalent time; two sampled rates are not a timing bound.
Negative discrepancy/rates yield nonnegative sensitivity, not signed event correction.
A half-circle discrepancy is directionally ambiguous; larger discrepancies are outside the principal circular branch.
Zero, tiny and opposing rates are refused even with zero discrepancy.
The declared ten-percent gate is inclusive and rejects larger spread; denominator is max absolute rate.
Nonfinite observations, malformed rates and arithmetic overflow fail closed.
An unaligned or missing convention declaration blocks even numerically benign conversion.
Zero discrepancy at a permitted rate gives zero; exact minimum rate passes the declared heuristic.
A discrepancy above a near-cusp margin or on its endpoint proves no label change or interval guarantee.
A formal 600-second ratio is retained and flagged beyond sampled ±300 seconds, with no postmeasurement gate change.
